header.description: What: CE-4615 (the command chain on a battalion slice, real squads, ~64 men) - on demo-city, 'Blue Battalion HQ' (SupportCommand, 2 x 81 mm) over 'Blue Company' (three platoons of 2 x 4, 2 IFVs on the start line), ordered CompanyAttack at 30 s on Objective 1 (425,425) then Objective 2 (645,445), deadline 300 s; 'Red Battalion HQ' (SupportCommand, its reserve platoon held back) over 'Red Company' (CompanyDefend: a line facing west at Objective 1, its depth and fall-back at Objective 2) and a 2-man 'Red Outpost' forward. No traffic, no civilians. Judge: Red's chain: a thin line is LOST => the weak company reserve counter-attacks; the company goes RED => REQUEST Reinforce => the battalion HQ sends its reserve platoon (CompanyDefend / PlatoonDefend by echelon) — each arrow found in /squad/reports and the order journal IN ORDER and CAUSED by the one before. End: Blue holds Objective 2 for 120 s, Red below 30 %, or 15 min. Check: python3 scripts/utility-demo-check.py --launch cc-battalion-collapse. 📄 docs/designs/group-maneuvers/DESIGN_Command_Chain_Battalion_Test.md (CE-4615)
